description: Piped water connection on the premises of a household; includes utility and small piped scheme connections
exposure_from_input: unimproved or surface water | improved not on premises
exposure_to: improved on premises (or improved on premises with higher water quality when water quality at the tap is verified)
effect_rule: if water_quality_verified then (from unimproved: F_WAT_PREMHQ_FROM_UNIMP; from improved: F_WAT_PREMHQ_FROM_IMPNP) else (from unimproved: F_WAT_PREM_FROM_UNIMP; from improved: F_WAT_PREM_FROM_IMPNP)
adjustment_ids: ADJ_USE_CONNECTION; ADJ_DECAY_WATSUP; ADJ_HH_SIZE; ADJ_U5_SHARE; ADJ_PAF_CF_WATER; ADJ_EPISODE_DURATION_U5
outcomes_reported: people reached; diarrhoea cases averted (under five); deaths and DALYs averted (PAF route; all ages and under five); direct mortality band (F_MORT_WATSUP); STH if prevalence supplied
people_per_unit_rule: people = households x mean household size (country) unless the enterprise reports persons per connection
notes: The effect is on the water quality and quantity actually used; a connection whose water is intermittent or recontaminated carries the unverified-quality row

description: Piped connection to a school or health facility
effect_rule: no effect row: the pooled evidence is household based; institutional water supply alone has no pooled diarrhoea estimate
outcomes_reported: people reached (pupils or patients as reported by the enterprise); no health conversion
people_per_unit_rule: people = pupils or patients reported per institution (required input)
notes: Reported as reach; a school handwashing or hygiene programme delivered with the connection can use P_HYG_PRODUCT

unit_of_output: water points or kiosks in operation
description: Shared improved source off premises: standpipe or handpump or kiosk or refill station (including kiosks selling treated water)
effect_rule: F_WAT_IMPNP_FROM_UNIMP (the treated-water kiosk gain over an improved off-premises source has no pooled estimate)
adjustment_ids: ADJ_USE_CONNECTION; ADJ_DECAY_WATSUP; ADJ_HH_SIZE; ADJ_U5_SHARE; ADJ_PAF_CF_WATER; ADJ_EPISODE_DURATION_U5
outcomes_reported: people reached; diarrhoea cases averted (under five); deaths and DALYs averted (PAF route); direct mortality band (F_MORT_WATSUP); STH if prevalence supplied
people_per_unit_rule: people = users per water point reported by the enterprise (required input); customers who already used an improved source are excluded from the exposure change
notes: Evidence gap for kiosks and refill stations as a service model (single trials only)

description: Household filter (ceramic or biosand or membrane or Lifestraw type) with safe storage
exposure_from_input: unimproved or surface water | improved not on premises
effect_rule: from unimproved: F_POU_FILTER_FROM_UNIMP; from improved: F_POU_FILTER_FROM_IMPNP
adjustment_ids: ADJ_USE_FILTER_REF; ADJ_DECAY_POU; ADJ_HH_SIZE; ADJ_U5_SHARE; ADJ_PAF_CF_WATER; ADJ_EPISODE_DURATION_U5
outcomes_reported: people reached; diarrhoea cases averted (under five); deaths and DALYs averted (PAF route); direct mortality band (F_MORT_POU_KREMER; F_MORT_POU_SW); STH if prevalence supplied
people_per_unit_rule: people = filters x mean household size (country) unless the enterprise reports household size
notes: Year one moderate; later years low because of the decay proxy

description: Chlorine tablets or solution or dispenser access for household water treatment
exposure_from_input: unimproved or surface water | improved not on premises
effect_rule: from unimproved: F_POU_CHLOR_FROM_UNIMP; from improved: F_POU_CHLOR_FROM_IMPNP
adjustment_ids: ADJ_USE_CHLOR_REF; ADJ_DECAY_POU; ADJ_HH_SIZE; ADJ_U5_SHARE; ADJ_PAF_CF_WATER; ADJ_EPISODE_DURATION_U5
outcomes_reported: people reached; diarrhoea cases averted (under five); deaths and DALYs averted (PAF route); direct mortality band (F_MORT_POU_KREMER; F_MORT_POU_SW); STH if prevalence supplied
people_per_unit_rule: people = household-years supplied x mean household size (country)
notes: Blinded trials found no effect; reporting bias flag applies

exposure_from_input: unimproved or surface water | improved not on premises

outcomes_reported: people reached; diarrhoea cases averted (under five); deaths and DALYs averted (PAF route); direct mortality band (F_MORT_POU_KREMER; F_MORT_POU_SW)

unit_of_output: households served by a chlorinated source
description: Chlorination at the source or in the pipe or at the kiosk (dispenser or in-line device) so that the water collected is chlorinated
exposure_from_input: unimproved or surface water | improved not on premises
effect_rule: from unimproved: F_POU_CHLOR_FROM_UNIMP; from improved: F_POU_CHLOR_FROM_IMPNP (proxy: no pooled estimate for in-line chlorination)
adjustment_ids: ADJ_USE_CHLOR_REF; ADJ_DECAY_POU; ADJ_HH_SIZE; ADJ_U5_SHARE; ADJ_PAF_CF_WATER; ADJ_EPISODE_DURATION_U5
outcomes_reported: people reached; diarrhoea cases averted (under five); deaths and DALYs averted (PAF route); direct mortality band (F_MORT_POU_KREMER)
people_per_unit_rule: people = households served x mean household size (country); verified use = share of samples with free chlorine residual at the point of collection
notes: Evidence gap: single trials (Pickering 2019 Bangladesh; Odisha 2026) not pooled

description: Household toilet reaching at least basic service (improved and not shared) sold or installed by the enterprise
exposure_from_input: unimproved or limited sanitation or open defecation
effect_rule: if community_coverage_after >= ADJ_COV_SAN_THRESHOLD then F_SAN_BASIC_FROM_UNIMP and F_MORT_SAN_COMMUNITY else F_SAN_BASIC_HHTARGET and F_MORT_SAN_HHTARGET
adjustment_ids: ADJ_COV_SAN_THRESHOLD; ADJ_USE_SAN; ADJ_DECAY_SAN; ADJ_HH_SIZE; ADJ_U5_SHARE; ADJ_PAF_CF_SAN; ADJ_EPISODE_DURATION_U5
outcomes_reported: people reached; diarrhoea cases averted (under five); deaths and DALYs averted (PAF route); direct mortality band; STH if prevalence supplied
people_per_unit_rule: people = toilets x mean household size (country)
notes: Households that already had a basic toilet are excluded from the exposure change

description: Household connection to a sewer network
exposure_from_input: unimproved or limited sanitation or open defecation
effect_rule: F_SAN_SEWER_FROM_UNIMP (if the household already had basic sanitation no row applies: the basic to sewer transition RR 0.66 has a CI including no effect and is not carried)
adjustment_ids: ADJ_COV_SAN_THRESHOLD; ADJ_USE_SAN; ADJ_DECAY_SAN; ADJ_HH_SIZE; ADJ_U5_SHARE; ADJ_PAF_CF_SAN; ADJ_EPISODE_DURATION_U5
outcomes_reported: people reached; diarrhoea cases averted (under five); deaths and DALYs averted (PAF route); direct mortality band; STH if prevalence supplied
people_per_unit_rule: people = households x mean household size (country)
notes: Treatment of the collected sewage is not assessed by the evidence

output_type: container-based or on-site sanitation with a collection service
description: Container-based toilet or on-site toilet sold with a regular emptying and treatment service (FSM dependent)
exposure_from_input: unimproved or limited sanitation or open defecation
exposure_to: basic sanitation without sewer connection (modelled as basic; safely managed on-site has no pooled estimate)
effect_rule: same rule as P_SAN_BASIC; the safely managed step adds no factor
adjustment_ids: ADJ_COV_SAN_THRESHOLD; ADJ_USE_SAN; ADJ_DECAY_SAN; ADJ_HH_SIZE; ADJ_U5_SHARE; ADJ_PAF_CF_SAN; ADJ_EPISODE_DURATION_U5
outcomes_reported: people reached; diarrhoea cases averted (under five); deaths and DALYs averted (PAF route); direct mortality band; STH if prevalence supplied
people_per_unit_rule: people = toilets x mean household size (country)
notes: Evidence gap stated in every output: modelled as basic sanitation with the coverage rule

output_type: FSM or emptying service for existing toilets
description: Pit or septic tank emptying and transport and treatment for households that already have a toilet
effect_rule: no effect row: the pooled evidence contains no study of the basic to safely managed on-site transition
outcomes_reported: people reached (households served x household size); no health conversion; reported next to the sanitation pathway results
people_per_unit_rule: people = households served x mean household size (country)
notes: Evidence gap stated in every output; the service protects workers and neighbours but no conversion factor exists

description: Soap or handwashing station or hygiene kit delivered with at least one promotion contact
exposure_to: handwashing promotion with soap or a station
effect_rule: F_HYG_HW_PROMOTION when promotion contact is documented; product sales alone carry no row
adjustment_ids: ADJ_USE_HYG; ADJ_DECAY_HYG; ADJ_HH_SIZE; ADJ_U5_SHARE; ADJ_PAF_CF_HYG; ADJ_EPISODE_DURATION_U5
outcomes_reported: people reached; diarrhoea cases averted (under five); deaths and DALYs averted (PAF route); direct mortality band (F_MORT_HYG); STH if prevalence supplied
people_per_unit_rule: people = households x mean household size (country)
notes: Hygiene mortality effect depends on an improved water supply being present

output_type: menstrual health and hygiene product or service
description: Menstrual products or school facilities or education for menstrual health
effect_rule: no effect row by decision 4: no pooled health effect exists
outcomes_reported: girls and women reached; products or services delivered; school facilities meeting standards; attendance only where the enterprise measures it directly
people_per_unit_rule: people = girls and women reached as reported by the enterprise
notes: Separate outcome pathway reported next to the health estimates
